response.sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game) AS fraction_of_total, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game) AS ratio_to_avg_record FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUM(games) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ratio_to_avg_record DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average games value of a single home_game record is the global AVG(games) over all home_game rows, ignoring NULLs, not a per-team average.
The sum over all teams is SUM(games) across the whole home_game table, ignoring NULLs.
Totals are computed per team_id across all years, parks and leagues. Ratios use floating-point division (not integer division) and are unrounded.
